ap2_mandate_compliance.mandate_data_format: AP2 standardized mandate object with payment_method, amount, currency, mandate_type, sca_exemption_reason
ap2_mandate_compliance.mandate_lifecycle: CREATE → AUTHORIZE (SCA) → ACTIVE → COLLECT → AMEND → CANCEL
ap2_mandate_compliance.ucp_settlement_path: UCP settlement instruction with clearing_system, settlement_currency, value_date, settlement_finality
ap2_mandate_compliance.visa_intelligent_commerce: Visa IC — network tokenization via VTS, DPAN provisioning, cryptogram generation, device binding
ap2_mandate_compliance.tap_interop: Token Action Protocol — provision/activate/suspend/resume/delete lifecycle for network tokens

sca_exemption_schema.note: Exemption definitions and thresholds come from PSD2 and its regulatory technical standards — verify current rules with your acquirer.

dispute_evidence_requirements.represent_vs_refund: Business decision — follow your operator's dispute policy. AXIS does not publish win-rate estimates.
